sunairport.rule: A report cutoff does not stop collection. If the official D0 board is not yet available, continue polling and publish an incremental update when D0 appears. Never substitute D-1 as D0.

forward_demand_radar.purpose: Detect demand compression early enough for JoTrip inventory, pricing, vehicles, hosts and supplier commitments.

hotel.interpretation_rule: Observed OTA scarcity is not occupancy. Label it OTA availability pressure only.

alert_rules.watch: >=30% of fixed hotel basket unavailable on a comparable date/configuration
alert_rules.high: >=50% unavailable or median all-in rate rises >=20% vs comparable baseline
alert_rules.critical: >=70% unavailable in a target segment/zone or multiple key JoTrip hotels unavailable across adjacent dates
alert_rules.note: Thresholds are operating-policy v0.1, not calibrated occupancy probabilities.

reporting.daily_0600: show 14/30/60/90-day forward pressure calendar and only material changes
reporting.daily_1800: show material changes since morning when new inventory/rates are observed
reporting.weekly: full 90-day curve, peak-date clusters, source-market and airlift overlay
